Sonal Dinusha scored a maiden international hundred while Niroshan Dickwella made 80. Their partnership delayed the Sri Lankan collapse against the Indian attack. India hold a substantial first-innings lead after the rain-affected day.

title: UP ATS arrests man linked to Jaish-e-Mohammed sending funds to Pakistan

He reportedly solicited donations for a madrasa while attempting to funnel funds to Pakistan. Intelligence assessments highlighted his connections with Maulana Masood Azhar, as well as evidence of interactions with Pakistani jihadist groups through social media and phone records. The investigation unveiled damaging materials and admissions supporting the allegations.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40bn in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's philanthropic efforts have made a significant impact by enabling the cancellation of medical debt across the United States. By purchasing and eliminating patient debt at a minimal cost, she has set a precedent that encourages other wealthy individuals to invest in similar initiatives. Despite these immediate acts of generosity, the need for comprehensive policy reforms persists, as true transformation necessitates addressing the fundamental issues leading to medical debt.

title: She expected isolation in remote Alaska but found internet and Amazon deliveries
content: A 23-year-old woman who moved to a remote Alaskan island expected limited access to basic necessities, poor internet and difficult travel. Instead, she found grocery stores, coffee shops, reliable internet, Amazon deliveries and regular flights. While travel takes more planning and deliveries can take weeks, she has maintained her career, supported local businesses and embraced outdoor activities.

title: 100 teachers receive over $9,000 each in life-changing bonuses

The donor hopes her action will inspire others to support public education.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes a 'vacation request' to employees for this month

This temporary policy adjustment is designed to bolster staff presence as the company approaches the end of its financial year. Following disappointing quarterly results and a forecasted drop in revenue, Accenture is permitting employees to carry over unused vacation days into the next fiscal year to help enhance fourth-quarter outputs and revenue generation.

His efficiency is highlighted by reaching this landmark in under 100 matches.

title: Who are ‘silver tooth kids’ and why is the internet calling them ‘bad’?
content: The internet often links children sporting silver dental crowns to unruly behavior, but this is a misguided stereotype. These crowns, made of stainless steel, serve a critical purpose: they protect damaged baby teeth from decay and maintain structure. It's essential to dispel the idea that a child's dental work signifies anything about their character or their parenting, as these treatments are purely preventive.

title: India’s biggest urban problem might not be potholes. It could be us
content: Indian cities invest heavily in infrastructure, yet many problems arise from everyday human behavior.  Overflowing bins and parked cars on sidewalks highlight this ongoing civic failure.  Traffic rule violations and littering demonstrate a cultural contradiction in public space treatment.  Keeping cities clean requires municipal systems, enforcement, and citizen behavior working together.  Becoming smarter citizens is the real test of India's urban transformation.

title: Buying property near beaches or water bodies? 10 laws and rules buyers should know
content: Investing in waterfront properties necessitates a solid grasp of environmental and land-use regulations. Essential guidelines include the Coastal Regulation Zone Notification 2019 and the Wetlands Rules 2017. The Environment Protection Act 1986 offers a comprehensive legal framework for these locations. It’s imperative for buyers to confirm property titles and access rights according to the relevant laws. Additionally, local building and zoning regulations outline what constructions are permissible.

content: the move allowed Washington to bypass Iran’s official negotiators, including parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf and foreign minister Abbas Araghchi, amid growing doubts over whether they had the authority to speak for the IRGC . the concerns emerged in mid-may, as a u.s. negotiating team began questioning whether Iran was actually in a position to make commitments to the powerful military force .

title: BJP announces list of office bearers: Smriti Irani, Piyush Goyal get key roles
content: BJP announces new team of national office-bearers . smriti Irani, Piyush Goyal among those given key organisational responsibilities . former chief minister Vasundhara Raje Scindia, Baijayant Jay Panda and Rekha Verma retained as vice presidents .

title: Iran nuclear post: How a fabricated X claim by Indian account created panic in Israel, US
content: the false claim emerged on august 5 when an anonymous account on X in India posted that Brig. Gen. Ahmad Vahidi had said Iran would not abandon its nuclear weapons ambitions as long as Israel and the United States possessed such weapons . the claim quickly gained traction, with Israeli accounts and media outlets repeating it before it reached senior political figures in the united states .

title: USS Benfold spent 4 days without toilets, AC, galley after power failure in S China Sea
content: a US Navy guided-missile destroyer spent four days without working toilets, galley services . the ship suffered an "engineering casualty involving its generators," a spokesperson says . no injuries were reported aboard the ship in the south china sea .

title: Amit Shah hails crackdown on ISI-backed Shahzad Bhatti network
content: more than 200 operatives were arrested and plans for subversive attacks were thwarted . he said coordinated operations were carried out across 14 states to dismantle the network . the network was involved in espionage, including grenades bearing Pakistan Ordnance Factory markings .

title: BJP rejig: Amit Malviya removed as IT cell chief after 11 yrs; Mhaske takes over
content: the BJP has appointed amit Malviya as social media convener . he was retained as IT cell head in an earlier organisational revamp . the new social media team is bringing in several new faces ahead of upcoming assembly elections .
